en_quote: AFC compliance systems have become more complex and effective, increasing the demand for improved data.
knowledge_zh: 金融犯罪防控合规系统日益复杂有效，推动了对改进数据的需求

en_quote: As this module shows, data governance, preparation, management, and quality control are essential in financial crime compliance systems.
knowledge_zh: 数据治理、准备、管理和质量控制是金融犯罪合规系统的关键要素

en_quote: Internal and external data sources play key roles in compliance onboarding, screening, and monitoring.
knowledge_zh: 内部和外部数据源在合规准入、筛查和监控中发挥关键作用

en_quote: This module covers the techniques and tools for moving and using data within the organization.
knowledge_zh: 本模块涵盖组织内数据移动和使用的技术与工具

en_quote: Validation and testing processes help detect anomalies and maintain data integrity, accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
knowledge_zh: 验证和测试流程有助于检测异常并维护数据完整性、准确性、完整性和一致性

en_quote: This module also examines the processes needed to enhance data reliability, support regulatory compliance, and optimize financial crime detection systems.
knowledge_zh: 本模块还考察了增强数据可靠性、支持监管合规和优化金融犯罪检测系统的流程
